text: {"summary":"Task: repair Python 3.11 project; entrypoint engine.solve(data); submit complete replacements for only engine.py and rules.py, no third-party libraries/tools/network/workspace. 8 stages total; requirements through stage 3 are supplied, later requirements unknown. Public pass is provisional. No external verification. Current checkpoint has 4 public checks passed; stage 1 receipt had 2 and stage 2 receipt had 4. Stage 3 has two public tests but no result receipt.\nContract so far: input packages maps names to rows {version:int,deps:list}; roots maps package names to inclusive [min,max]. Install exactly the dependency closure of roots. Every active dependency of a selected version, now specified as {name,min,max}, must also be installed at a version in its inclusive interval. Version choices may require backtracking. Among feasible installations maximize the tuple of versions in sorted order of ALL package names, using -1 for absent names. If impossible return {\"error\":\"unsatisfiable\"}; otherwise {\"versions\":{name:version}}. Earlier stages described deps as names; stage 3 makes dependency entries range objects.\nCheckpoint artifact: engine calls resolve(data), returns unsatisfiable error when resolve returns None, otherwise wraps versions. rules.py searches recursively over required unassigned names, filters root choices by inclusive bounds, and compares complete assignments by the specified vector. It currently unions row deps directly into a set, which does not support stage-3 dependency dictionaries; it also does not enforce dependency ranges or validate ranges against an already assigned package. Thus requirements 1–2 are implemented in the checkpoint, but stage 3 remains outstanding. Stage 3 public examples: root a fixed at 1 with dependencies can yield a1,b1,c1; another allows a1,b2,c2. Public tests shown earlier are duplicate pairs; their limited scope does not establish correctness beyond stated checks. Initial artifact and earlier candidates are included in history, but checkpoint_artifact is the latest supplied artifact."}
